cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Tell the committee we're considering the festival bid. Just the announcement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Once they've reserved the date, we'll have something worth protecting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I prefer starting with the consequence that encourages us.

mechanism: A coaches its former committee pupil into reserving a festival date so public expectations make the still-undecided risky bid feel underway.
confusable: Not approval for a secret different plan: the known bid remains undecided, but a small public consequence is used to pressure later assent.
comparison: Deposit at risk versus public calendar slot needing defense.
seedUse: D224 considering bid/announcement/not decided/reserved date/backwards; S05 committee speaking.
